with account_filter_cte as (
  select account_id

  from revops.accounts

  where region in (${region:singlequote})
    and sub_region in (${sub_region:singlequote})
    and segment in (${segment:singlequote})
    and account_owner in (${account_owner:singlequote})
    and solutions_engineer in (${solutions_engineer:singlequote})
)

select count(distinct(CASE WHEN stage_number between 3 and 6 and net_nacv > 0 THEN o.account_id ELSE null END)) as ct_accts_qp
  , (count(distinct(CASE WHEN stage_number between 3 and 6 and net_nacv > 0 THEN o.account_id ELSE null END))) / CAST(NULLIF(count(distinct(o.account_id)), 0) AS NUMERIC) as share_accts_qp

from revops.opportunities as o

inner join account_filter_cte on account_filter_cte.account_id = o.account_id

    and account_owner in (${account_owner:singlequote})
    and solutions_engineer in (${solutions_engineer:singlequote})
)

select coalesce(tam_category, '0. None') as label
  , count(a.account_id) as ct

from revops.accounts as a

inner join account_filter_cte on account_filter_cte.account_id = a.account_id

GROUP BY 1

order by 1 desc

    and account_owner in (${account_owner:singlequote})
    and solutions_engineer in (${solutions_engineer:singlequote})
)

select o.opp_id
  , a.account_name
  , o.opp_type
  , o.stage_name
  , o.fiscal_quarter
  , o.close_date
  , o.net_nacv

from revops.opportunities as o

inner join account_filter_cte as f on f.account_id = o.account_id

inner join revops.accounts as a on a.account_id = o.account_id

where o.close_date between CAST('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}' AS DATE) and CAST('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}' AS DATE)
  and o.stage_number <= 6

order by o.net_nacv desc, a.account_name, o.opp_id
